IGUI_RR_Note_Place:
K&L 800, GP7. Muldraugh depot, covered stall.
Found cold and parked.
[E] beside her - board the cab.
[E] in the cab - get off (she stops first).
Or right-click her: climb in / leave.
[V] - cab menu: sleep, headlight, leave.
Order: board -> reverser to N -> start [W].
On a controller: interact climbs in and out.
Her controls are on the pad too - see below.
On a server: one driver, the rest ride.
Server only: [V] takes or gives up the controls.
Log out in the cab - your seat is kept.
IGUI_RR_Note_Start:
STARTING
Reverser to N or the starter will not turn.
Tap [W] - one start attempt.
Runs itself: prime ~1.5s, then crank ~1.6s.
No catch - tap [W] again, the prime is kept.
Caught - ~4s warm-up, limited power.
Every attempt drains the battery.
Worse odds: cold, stale fuel. Rain does not.
No fuel or a flat battery - no start.
SHUTTING DOWN
Tap [S] at notch 0 and at a standstill.
PAD: D-pad up starts, D-pad down shuts down.
IGUI_RR_Note_Run:
[R] - reverser: N -> FORWARD -> REVERSE -> N.
Move it only at a standstill.
At N the throttle is locked, amperes read 0.
[W] notch up, [S] notch down. 0 to 8.
Power only with the diesel running.
Hold [Space] - air brake.
Order: throttle to 0, then brake.
ON A CONTROLLER
D-pad up / down - throttle. Left - reverser.
Right stick click - brake. It stays set;
click again to release it.
D-pad right, held - the cab menu.
IGUI_RR_Note_Panel:
Six dials: speed, amperes, brake air,
engine revs, fuel, water.
Water is temperature, not a supply.
Amperes = real pull. Throttle open and the
needle at 0 means she will not move.
With the diesel off the throttle quadrant is
the starter: START / PRIME / CRANK / WARMING.
LAMPS
HEAD, CAB - a light is on.
GEN - the diesel is running.
BATT: amber - few starts left in her,
red - the starter will not turn.
COND: amber - power is dropping,
red - she can stall on her own.
IGUI_RR_Note_Signals:
Hold [Q] - horn.
[L] - bell, toggles and rings by itself.
Both run off the compressor: with the diesel
shut down there are no signals.
[F] - headlight: on / off, as in a car.
It burns off the end the reverser has picked.
[Shift+F] - cab dome light.
By its light you can read in the cab at night.
The number boards light the number itself and
burn whenever she has any charge at all.
Headlight and dome drain the battery; the
boards do not. Left on, they will flatten her.
PAD: left bumper - horn. Right - bell.
The headlight is on the cab menu.
IGUI_RR_Note_Fuel:
She burns fuel at idle too - shut her down.
DIESEL only - petrol is no use to her.
Can: right-click the loco ->
'Pour diesel into locomotive'.
Bulk tanks: Muldraugh depot; Valley Station
freight terminal: platform road, not main.
-> 'Refuel locomotive from the tank'
   (she must be standing at it);
-> 'Fill container from the tank'.
Each tank has its own finite reserve.
Siphoning diesel back out needs a hose.
The battery drains on starts and lights.
Flat - a running generator nearby, then
crank. There is no depot charger.
IGUI_RR_Note_Track:
SWITCHES
Right-click the switch -> 'Railroad switch':
main line (straight) or diverging track.
The setting is saved.
HITS
Fence, sign, cone, door, tree - smashed.
Concrete - near stop, can be pushed through.
Car on a crossing - crumpled and thrown off.
On a server she destroys it instead, and
below about 4 m/s she stops at it.
Freight car, locomotive - hard stop.
Every hit takes condition (COND).
Condition 0 - OUT OF ORDER, engine dies.
IGUI_RR_Note_Repair:
REPAIR
Right-click her -> 'Repair locomotive
with a wrench'. Five minutes of work,
+5%% of condition, one point off the wrench.
Twenty passes bring her back from zero;
a wrench is good for nine of them.
No skill, no depot, no parts needed.
Duct tape works too: +0.5%% a strip, four
strips to a roll, and it refuses above 10%%.
Enough to get a dead engine turning over
and limp to the depot. At 10%% she pulls
badly and stalls.
IGUI_RR_Note_Derail:
DERAILING is permanent.
1. Broken track (open rail end) at speed.
2. A very hard impact (about 8 m/s or more).
Derailed: engine dead, controls dead.
Solo: she cannot be put back.
On a server: right-click her and put her
back on the rails. Temporary - until the
proper re-railing gear exists.
